message.content:
Replaced the `FieldBase` copy-constructor call with the cheaper `FieldDefinition` constructor and a direct vector assignment, avoiding an extra `SetValues` call. This preserves identical state while reducing per-copy function-call overhead.

```cpp
Field::Field(const Field &field)
    : FieldBase(field.fieldDefinition)
    , profile(field.profile)
    , profileIndex(field.profileIndex)
    , type(field.type)
    , isFieldExpanded(field.isFieldExpanded)
{
    values = field.values;
}
```
